dominant_strengths: Faithful reproduction of Airbnb's native system: pill search, tab nav, card grid feel authentic and production-ready
Strong card craft with consistent radii, favorite hearts, 'Guest favorite' chips, and clear price/rating hierarchy
Comfortable horizontal rhythm and generous whitespace make scanning rows of listings effortless
dominant_weaknesses: Zero innovation beyond mimicking the live product—no novel surface, interaction, or informational angle proposed
Reflective layer is thin: cards repeat near-identical metadata strings without storytelling, vibe, or differentiation cues
NEW badges on Experiences/Services float awkwardly above icons, breaking the otherwise tight nav alignment
fix_priorities: Introduce a distinctive editorial or contextual layer (mood, neighborhood story, trip-fit) to escape pure clone territory
Refine nav badge placement and sizing so 'NEW' chips integrate with icons rather than collide with them
Diversify card metadata—surface host, amenities, or vibe tags instead of repeating price/rating templates
Add subtle motion affordances (carousel hover, image fade) hints to lift motion_elegance
rationale.norman_balance: Strong behavioral usability and decent visceral polish, but reflective meaning is weak because it copies rather than reinterprets Airbnb.
rationale.intent_fit: It convincingly executes an Airbnb home page but contributes nothing the real product doesn't already do better.
